units.source_text: 事情已经做了，也没办法追问。

en.t: The thing was already done, and there was no way to press her about it.

units.source_text: 但至少要对女人说，让她再详细地把事情说一说。

en.t: But at the very least, he had to tell the woman to explain the matter in more detail.

units.source_text: 只要搞清楚事态，自然也就能找出对付的办法了。

en.t: As long as he understood the situation clearly, he would naturally be able to find a way to deal with it.

units.source_text: 不可能没有对付的办法。

en.t: It was impossible that there was no way to deal with it.
How could such an absurd thing be possible...

units.source_text: 但是，不管你怎么说，女人要是坚持一言不发你怎么办呢……

en.t: But no matter what you said, what would you do if the woman insisted on saying nothing at all...

units.source_text: 只有这个是最令人恐惧的回答。

en.t: That alone was the most terrifying answer.

units.source_text: 然而，似乎充分具有这种可能性。

en.t: And yet that possibility seemed entirely real.

units.source_text: 女人的这个顽固的沉默……

en.t: This stubborn silence of the woman...

units.source_text: 这种卑躬屈膝、完全无防备的活牺牲品姿势……

en.t: This groveling, utterly defenseless posture of a living sacrifice...
